# Security

## Reporting a vulnerability in PWE Screen Encore

Please report privately to **support@pwestudio.site**, not in a public issue.

Include the version (shown in About), the Macs involved and their macOS versions,
and what you observed. We will reply within a few working days, and tell you
when a fix is released.

## How this relates to TargetBridge

PWE Screen Encore is a build of [TargetBridge](https://github.com/swellweb/targetBridge).
When a problem is in TargetBridge's code, we report it privately to its maintainer as
TargetBridge's own policy asks, and offer a fix. Our build may ship that fix before
it appears upstream; its release notes will not describe the problem until the
maintainer has had time to respond.

To report a problem in TargetBridge itself, follow
[TargetBridge's security policy](../SECURITY.md).

## Supported versions

Only the latest release is supported.

# 安全

发现 PWE Screen Encore 的安全问题，请私下发邮件到 **support@pwestudio.site**，不要开公开的 issue。

请写明版本号（在「关于」里）、涉及的两台 Mac 和各自的 macOS 版本，以及你看到了什么。
我们会在几个工作日内回复，修复发布时会告诉你。

问题出在 TargetBridge 的代码里时，我们会按它的安全政策私下告诉它的维护者，并附上修复。
我们的版本可能先于上游发布修复；在维护者有时间回应之前，发布说明不会描述问题本身。

只支持最新版本。
